blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Legal judgment prediction models may retain a guilty verdict after a legally decisive condition has been altered such that the specified charge is no longer established. We study this guilty bias via selective repair over matched charge-established and charge-not-established cases, where the unsupported verdict should change while its supported counterpart remains stable. We construct CAIL-MC, a legally reviewed dataset of 11,478 matched pairs covering 261 Chinese criminal charges. Held-out activation interventions show that contrasts learned from correctly resolved pairs transfer to false-guilty cases, but target-reaching interventions can also damage matched supported-guilty decisions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce PROSE, which reconstructs case-specific targets from a training-derived residual geometry, aligns them with a local margin-descent signal, attenuates supported-guilty-sensitive components, and realizes bounded targets through a preservation-regularized low-rank parameter update. Across Qwen3-8B and GLM4-9B, PROSE achieves stronger pairwise safe repair and evidence sensitivity, while preserving standard single-pass inference.
blocks.zh: 法律判决预测模型在改变法律决定条件,规定的指控不再成立后,可以保留有罪判决。 我们通过有选择地修复已立案和未立案的对等案件来研究这种有罪偏见,在这些案件中,没有支持的判决应当改变,而得到支持的对等案件则保持稳定。 我们构建了CAIL-MC,一个经法律审查的11 478对匹配的数据集,涵盖261项中国刑事指控。 暂停激活干预表明,从正确解决的对子案件转移到虚假有罪案件中所学到的对比,但目标明确的干预也可能损害与支持的有罪决定相符。 基于这一观察,我们引入了PROSE,它从培训衍生的剩余几何学中重建了具体案例目标,使其与局部差值-差值信号一致,减弱了支持的有罪敏感成分,并通过保存-规范的低排名参数更新实现捆绑目标。 通过Quen3-8B和GLM4-9B,ProSE实现了更强的对偶安全修复和证据敏感性,同时保留了标准的单传推论.

Legal judgment prediction (LJP) Zhong et al. (2018) ; Zhang and Dou (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2023) ; Shi et al. (2025) ; Han et al. (2025) asks whether case facts establish a
criminal charge. Beyond recognizing patterns in prior cases, an LJP system
should respond to legally decisive changes in the evidence. In particular,
when the available facts do not establish a charge, the principle of in dubio pro reo Raimondo (2020) requires doubt to be resolved in favor of the
accused.

blocks.en:
Recent approaches reduce false-guilty predictions through additional non-guilty supervision Zhang et al. (2025) , defense-oriented interaction Jeong and Lee (2026) , self-refinement Madaan et al. (2023) , or
debate Chen et al. (2025) . Although they have achieved encouraging results, three challenges remain. First , aggregate error reduction does not establish evidence-sensitive correction. A lower false-guilty rate (FGR) may result from a general downward shift in guilty scores, which can simultaneously increase the false-nonguilty rate (FNR). As illustrated in
Figure 1 (b), reducing one error direction does not necessarily improve the other. Correction should therefore respond to the decisive legal
contrast rather than merely favor charge-not-established predictions. Second , repairability does not guarantee selective repair. Even an intervention
that moves a false-guilty case across the decision boundary may weaken the supported verdict of its matched charge-established counterpart or alter
unrelated correct predictions. A useful correction must therefore preserve both the paired counterpart and broader non-target behavior. Third , existing data-based correction requires multi-step training, whereas inference-time critique and debate repeat deliberation for every case. A practical correction should persist after a one-time update without requiring full retraining or repeated model calls at inference time.

CAIL2018 Xiao et al. (2018) , contains 11,478

Guided by three-stage legal

We then test whether the base LLM contains an internal signal that can
support such a correction. Hidden-state contrasts estimated from correctly
resolved training pairs reduce the guilty margins of held-out false-guilty
cases.
Yet interventions strong enough to
reach a charge-not-established target also reduce the margins of their matched
supported-guilty cases.
This diagnosis exposes the central repair–preservation tension wherein errors are often internally repairable, but the available repair signal is not inherently selective.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this finding, we introduce PROSE, a
preservation-constrained selective editing method.
PROSE addresses the repair–preservation tension in three stages.
(1) it reconstructs each training target’s matched residual within the geometry
learned from correctly resolved training pairs and defines a family of repair directions by interpolating the reconstruction with the negative gradient of the target verdict margin.
The residual component transfers structure from
successfully resolved legal contrasts, whereas the gradient provides a target-local signal for reducing the guilty margin.
(2) PROSE attenuates components
sensitive to supported-guilty behavior and searches within a case-adaptive cap for a small displacement that reaches a conservative negative margin.
This reduces overlap with protected behavior and limits unnecessary movement beyond the decision boundary.
(3) PROSE realizes the feasible activation targets through preservation-regularized least squares over supported-guilty and non-target examples, followed by low-rank truncation and norm-bounded rescaling. Preservation is thus promoted during both target construction and parameter fitting. After this offline editing phase, the model performs ordinary single-pass inference.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold:
(1) We formulate guilty-bias mitigation as preservation-constrained selective
repair and introduce PROSE, which realizes bounded activation targets
through a preservation-regularized parameter update.
(2) We construct CAIL-MC with two complementary tracks:
the Pairwise Repair–Preservation Track contains 11,478 reviewed matched
pairs across 261 charges, while the Evidence-Sufficiency Generalization
Track tests four evidence conditions from unseen corpora.
(3) Experiments on two backbones demonstrate stronger pairwise safe repair
than LJP and editing baselines, greater evidence sensitivity than SFT,
and less supported-verdict damage than a repair-matched uniform shift,
with lower offline cost than SFT and ordinary single-pass inference.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
LJP maps case facts to judicial outcomes such as applicable law articles, charges, and sentences. Zhong et al. (2018) model dependencies among these prediction subtasks,
while Hu et al. (2018) address few-shot charge prediction through
discriminative legal attributes. Xu et al. (2020) focus on distinguishing confusing law articles, and Lyu et al. (2022) improve prediction through criminal-element
extraction.
More recent work incorporates legal precedents ( Wu et al., 2023 ) and studies multi-task or multi-label prediction in
more realistic settings ( Li et al., 2025 ) .

而Hu等人(2018年)则通过微波射电荷预测
歧视性法律属性。 许等(2020年)注重区分混淆的法律条款,而Lyu等. (2022) 通过犯罪要素改进预测
提取。
最近的工作包括法律先例 (Wu等,2023年)并研究多任务或多标签预测
更现实的设置(Li等,2025.).

blocks.en:
Recently, non-guilty judgment has received increasing attention. Zhang et al. (2025) introduces charge-not-established outcomes and structures prediction
around offense elements, unlawfulness, and culpability. Jeong and Lee (2026) characterizes the tendency to over-predict guilt as guilty bias and uses an inference-time lawyer agent to challenge guilty
assumptions at each reasoning stage.
These approaches expand LJP beyond guilty-centered prediction, but do not
explicitly formulate correction as a matched requirement: changing an
unsupported verdict while preserving its minimally different supported
counterpart.

blocks.en:
We address this gap by formulating guilty-bias mitigation as preservation-constrained selective repair . Each matched legal pair
jointly specifies a charge-not-established verdict to correct and a supported charge-established verdict to preserve. We realize these pairwise constraints through a persistent parameter update, connecting our approach to model editing ( Meng et al., 2022 ) . MEMIT ( Meng et al., 2023 ) performs scalable parameter updates to factual associations, while AlphaEdit ( Fang et al., 2025 ) projects updates into a null space
associated with preserved knowledge. Unlike these factual editing methods, we modify an asymmetric
behavioral relation within each legal pair: the charge-not-established member
should change, while its charge-established counterpart and broader
non-target behavior should remain stable.

blocks.en:
CAIL-MC comprises two complementary tracks under the same
charge-conditioned verification task. The Pairwise
Repair–Preservation Track (track 1) evaluates whether a model corrects an unsupported
verdict while preserving its closest supported counterpart. The Evidence-Sufficiency Generalization Track (track 2) evaluates whether this
behavior transfers when both the source corpus and the construction of
evidential support change.

blocks.en:
Based on CAIL2018 ( Xiao et al., 2018 ) , we construct
11,478 charge-established/charge-not-established pairs spanning 261 Chinese
criminal charges. Following the three-stage legal reasoning perspective ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) ,
each pair changes one decisive condition concerning offense elements,
unlawfulness, or culpability while preserving the surrounding facts as
closely as possible. The charge-not-established member specifies the verdict
that should change, whereas its matched charge-established member provides
the closest preservation control. The legal-stage annotation organizes
contrast construction and the stage-specific statistics used later; it is
not an additional prediction target. Construction includes outcome-expression
removal, legal-condition planning, counterfactual generation, automated
factual and legal checks, and stratified inspection by criminal-law
annotators.
Variants derived from the same source case are assigned to the
same split, with the stage distribution preserved across splits.
The construction details are provided in App. A.1 .

blocks.en:
To evaluate behavior beyond the matched construction, we derive four
evidence conditions from LeCaRD Ma et al. (2021) and Criminal-S Hu et al. (2018) cases.
The full-supported condition retains the complete facts supporting the
candidate charge, while partial-sufficient removes non-essential
information but retains sufficient support. In contrast, partial-insufficient preserves some charge-related facts but withholds
decisive support, and allegation-only retains the accusation without
supporting factual evidence. The first two conditions are labeled charge
established, and the latter two charge not established. In particular we adopt partial-sufficient controls for shortcuts rooted in input length or retained information volume because a shorter description need not imply insufficient support. This track therefore tests whether a model retains supported charges
but rejects them when the presented evidence is insufficient, operationalizing
one measurable consequence of in dubio pro reo under joint corpus
and evidence-construction shift. The construction details are provided in App. A.2 .

blocks.en: We conduct experiments to address the following research questions: RQ1: Does PROSE reduce false-guilty verdicts without trading them for false non-guilty ones, on matched pairs and on evidence-graded cases from unseen corpora? RQ2: Does PROSE repair the unsupported member while preserving its supported counterpart, rather than shifting all verdicts? RQ3: Which preservation components make the repair selective? RQ4: What does the correction cost, offline and at inference?

blocks.en: 6.2 Main Results (RQ1)
blocks.zh: 6.2 主要成果(RQ1)

blocks.en:
To evaluate guilty-bias reduction and selective repair, we compare methods on both CAIL-MC tracks.
From Tab. 2 , we observe three patterns.
(1) PROSE achieves the highest in-corpus PSR among LJP and editing baselines on both backbones, demonstrating stronger joint repair and matched preservation. On CAIL2018 track, PROSE ranks second only to SFT and keeps both FNR and FGR at or below 8.61 (Qwen) and 15.04 (GLM), and its PSR is the highest after SFT.
(2) SFT achieves the strongest performance on matched pairs, yet this advantage does not carry over to evidence-sufficiency evaluation (Acc: 49.64–51.00), where false-guilty errors dominate (94.29–97.25).
(3) PROSE achieves the best cross-corpus Macro-F1 on GLM and competitive performance on Qwen, avoiding the extreme one-sided error profiles exhibited by several baselines. For example, Self-Refine on Qwen and MEMIT on GLM obtain low FGR at the
expense of high FNR.
These results distinguish PROSE’s joint repair and preservation from error reduction through a general verdict shift.

(1) ProSE在LJP中实现最高的公司内PSR,并在两个骨干上实现编辑基线,显示出更强的联合修复和相配的保存. 在CAIL2018赛道上,PROSE排名仅次于SFT,并将FNR和FGR都保持在或低于8.61(Quen)和15.04(GLM),其PSR是仅次于SFT的最高.
(2) SFT在配对上取得了最强的性能,然而这一优势并没有延续到证据充分性评价(Acc:49.64-51.00),在这种评价中,假证错误占主导地位(94.29-97.25)。

blocks.en: To investigate whether PROSE repairs false-guilty decisions while preserving supported verdicts, we track the joint predictions of each test pair before and after correction (Fig 4 a–b). Most false-guilty pairs become jointly correct, and most originally correct pairs remain correct. Nevertheless, false-non-guilty pairs increase, showing that repair still incurs a preservation cost.

blocks.en: We further compare PROSE with a uniform margin offset calibrated to match its repair rate on base-misclassified charge-not-established cases. Damage is measured as the fraction of base-correct charge-established cases that become incorrect. At matched repair, PROSE causes substantially less damage: 8.5% versus 17.5% on Qwen and 7.1% versus 24.3% on GLM (Fig 4 c). Thus, PROSE preserves supported verdicts better than a uniform shift toward charge-not-established predictions, demonstrating more selective repair.

To investigate which preservation components support selective repair,
we remove target-level attenuation
(Eq. 8 ), parameter-level preservation constraints
(Eq. 11 ), or both, and refit each variant

Table 3 shows that removing parameter-level

Attenuation has a backbone-dependent effect: removing it substantially

Thus, parameter-level constraints consistently support selectivity, while attenuation improves Qwen’s repair–preservation balance.

blocks.en:
To investigate the computational cost of correction, we measure offline GPU-hours on one RTX 4080 SUPER and per-query latency relative to PROSE.
Fig. 5 shows that PROSE requires only 1.1/2.1 GPU-hours for Qwen/GLM, reducing offline cost by 3.1 3.1 – 8.1 × 8.1\times relative to SFT and LJPIV, while retaining ordinary single-pass inference; LJPIV additionally pays 2.1 2.1 – 3.0 × 3.0\times the latency because it queries the three legal stages separately.
MEMIT and AlphaEdit are cheaper offline but damage the unedited model on both tracks (Sec. 6.2 ), and inference-time reasoning methods need no training but incur 47 47 – 467 × 467\times the latency at every query.
Thus, PROSE is the only method that combines low cost on both axes with gains over the unedited model in every setting.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Guilty-bias mitigation requires correcting unsupported verdicts while preserving legally supported ones. We formalize this aim as
preservation-constrained selective repair and introduce PROSE, which constrains both activation-target construction and parameter fitting.
We also develop CAIL-MC consisting of two complementary tracks,
evaluating correction at both the matched-pair and evidential-support levels.
Across two backbones, PROSE achieves stronger pairwise safe repair than LJP and editing baselines and less supported-verdict damage than a
repair-matched uniform shift. While SFT excels on matched pairs, PROSE better responds to changing
evidential support under corpus and construction shift, with lower offline cost and ordinary single-pass inference.
blocks.zh:
减轻偏见要求纠正未得到支持的判决,同时保留得到法律支持的判决。 我们正式确定这一目标
保护性限制选择性修复并引入ProSE,这既限制了活性-目标构建,也限制了参数的匹配。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our study covers charge-conditioned verification based LJP in Chinese criminal
law using two backbones, rather than complete judicial decision-making.
CAIL-MC uses LLM-assisted transformations of adjudicated facts.
Independent legal review reduces, but cannot eliminate, generation
artifacts and uncertainty in legal interpretation. Its coverage-oriented
construction and selection of editable cases do not represent the
distribution of criminal cases in practice.
The Evidence-Sufficiency Generalization Track measures the sufficiency
of factual support available in the supplied text, not evidence
credibility or a judicial standard of proof. Its small source-case
sample and fixed allegation-only template limit the breadth of the
evaluation.
Finally, PROSE relies on paired training examples and backbone-specific
configuration choices. Its finite strength search may miss feasible
interventions, and parameter fitting approximates their activation
effects. Preservation is therefore empirical, not guaranteed.

blocks.en: A.1.1 Legal Path Planning
blocks.zh: A.1.1 法律道路规划

blocks.en:
Because fact descriptions extracted from original judgments may
contain expressions that reveal adjudicative outcomes, we first use DeepSeek-V4-Flash to extract and sanitize the case facts, removing conclusion-revealing expressions. The planning prompt P PLAN P_{\mathrm{PLAN}} then identifies candidate counterfactual paths for the cleaned case at three levels: elements of the offense,unlawfulness, and culpability.
blocks.zh:
因为从原判决中提取的事实描述可能
我们首先使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash来提取和消毒案件事实,去除结论-揭示表达。 Plan PQQ-mathrm{PLANX}在三个级别上确定了被清理案件的候选反事实路径:犯罪要素、不合法性和可负罪责。

blocks.en: Real-world guilty cases are naturally easier to modify by negating an element of the offense. Simply selecting the easiest construction would therefore over-concentrate the dataset on offense-level cases and reduce the coverage of unlawfulness and culpability. We thus first attempt eligible unlawfulness and culpability paths, ranking candidates according to the remaining coverage gap of each legal path, feasibility, and conflict risk. Here, a legal path denotes a concrete legal construction mechanism, such as self-defense and necessity under unlawfulness, or mental incapacity and age below criminal responsibility under culpability. Feasibility measures whether a complete counterfactual can be naturally constructed from the current case, whereas conflict risk measures whether the introduced facts are likely to contradict the original case facts or hard constraints. A case proceeds to offense-level construction only when no reasonable U/C path can satisfy the quality requirements.
blocks.zh: 真实世界的有罪案件自然更容易通过否认犯罪要素来修改。 因此,仅仅选择最简单的构思,就会过分集中关于犯罪级别案件的数据集,并减少非法性和可责罪性的覆盖面。 因此,我们首先尝试符合条件的非法性和可追究责任的途径,根据每一条法律途径的剩余覆盖面差距、可行性和冲突风险对候选人进行排名。 此处,法律途径是指具体的法律构建机制,如在不合法情况下的自卫和必要性,或者在应负罪责的情况下,精神丧失能力和低于刑事责任年龄。 能否从本案中自然地构建出完全相反的事实,而冲突风险衡量所介绍的事实是否可能与最初的案件事实相矛盾或硬性制约。 只有在没有合理的U/C路径能够满足质量要求时,案件才进入犯罪级别。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Counterfactual Generation
blocks.zh: A.1.2 反事实生成

blocks.en: Given the selected legal path, the counterfactual generation prompt P GEN P_{\mathrm{GEN}} instructs DeepSeek-V4-Flash to construct the corresponding charge-not-established fact description while preserving the original case facts as much as possible and introducing only the information necessary to alter the target legal condition.
blocks.zh: 鉴于选定的法律路径,反事实生成器会提示P GEN PQQMThrm{GEN}指示DeepSeek-V4-Flash构建相应的指控未确立的事实描述,同时尽可能保留原始案件事实,并仅引入改变目标法律条件所必要的信息.

blocks.en: Rather than mechanically appending exculpatory descriptions, we require the newly introduced facts to be adapted to the specific case context. For example, a self-defense counterfactual must be constructed around the original actors, course of aggression, and temporal relations, while a culpability-related modification must be consistent with the defendant’s specific identity and condition. This design avoids simply inserting fixed exculpatory keywords and makes the generated cases more consistent with realistic legal scenarios. To further prevent shortcut learning, the generated text is prohibited from directly containing conclusion-revealing expressions such as “not guilty” or “does not constitute a crime.”
blocks.zh: 我们要求新提出的事实适应具体案件的情况,而不是机械地附加开脱罪责的描述。 例如,自卫反事实必须围绕最初的行为者、侵略过程和时间关系来构建,而与责任有关的修改必须与被告的具体身份和条件相一致。 这种设计避免简单地插入固定的免责关键词,使生成的案件更符合现实的法律设想. 为进一步防止捷径学习,禁止生成的文本直接含有“无罪”或“不构成犯罪”等解析语。 “

blocks.en: The reported intervals are ± 1.96 \pm 1.96 bootstrap standard errors over 1,000 resamples (seed 42), i.e., normal-approximation 95% intervals. Pair-level metrics are computed on the fixed reference-defined strict false-guilty cohort, restricted to the resampled pairs that belong to it. At inference, it queries the three stages with its stage-wise prompt and reads each stage verdict from the logits.

Facts are truncated to 2,048 tokens within a context of 8,192, and the generation limits are 256 tokens for schema extraction, 192 for the judge, 320 for the lawyer, and 128 for the final answer.

blocks.en: MEMIT ( Meng et al., 2023 ) edits factual associations by treating MLP projections as key–value memories: it optimizes a target hidden value for each edit request and writes all requests into the weights at once with a closed-form least-squares update, regularized by the second moment of keys from preserved knowledge. AlphaEdit ( Fang et al., 2025 ) builds on this formulation but projects the update onto the null space of the preserved keys, so that the outputs for preserved inputs are left unchanged by construction. We adapt both to binary verdict repair. Their defining components are kept, and everything task-specific is matched to PROSE. • Requests, prompt, and readout. The edit requests are all strict false-guilty training pairs of each stage, without subsampling, scored with PROSE’s prompt and readout. • Location. Both editors write to the MLP down-projection of PROSE’s edited layer, their native write location, at the same three prompt positions; the stages are edited in the order Offense, Unlawfulness, Culpability. • Target values. As in the original methods, each request’s target is an additive vector on the down-projection output, optimized by back-propagation (Adam, learning rate 0.1, 25 steps, weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) with its norm clamped to 4 times the unedited output norm. The object likelihood is replaced by ReLU ​ ( s − τ ) 2 \mathrm{ReLU}(s-\tau)^{2} with PROSE’s endpoint τ \tau . • MEMIT preservation. The key second moment is estimated from 128 generic training references, which contain both members of their pairs and exclude the edit requests. The covariance weight is 3 × 10 3 3\times 10^{3} and the ridge 10 − 2 10^{-2} ; the update is solved exactly in Woodbury form. • AlphaEdit preservation. The null space of the key second moment of all non-request training cases (both members) is computed once on the unedited model, with eigenvalue threshold 10 − 2 10^{-2} and ridge 10 − 2 10^{-2} . Keys of earlier stage edits are accumulated as protected history for later stages, as in its sequential setting. Editor hyperparameters are tuned on the development split, and the test sets are loaded only after all edits are fitted. The editors differ from PROSE in how targets are obtained and in what is protected: generic reference keys rather than pools built around the matched pairs; they use neither PROSE’s rank cap nor its update budget.

blocks.en: PROSE involves no gradient-based training: given the training split and the selected configuration, each stage update is obtained by a closed-form ridge solve followed by rank truncation and rescaling. blocks.zh: PROSE不涉及以梯度为基础的培训:鉴于培训的分出和选定的配置,每个阶段的更新都通过封闭式山脊解析获得,然后是分级和分级。 继MEMIT和AlphaEdit(同样是闭式编辑器)之后,我们报告一次适当的运行(种子42)。

blocks.en: For each backbone and legal stage, the candidates combine an edited layer in the middle-layer region identified by the diagnosis, a contrast geometry (stage-specific or shared across stages), and values from the search space of Tab. 7 , including the contrast–gradient mixture λ \lambda . A candidate is admissible if, on the development split, it fits targets for its stage, retains at least 87% of the base-correct charge-established, same-stage, and cross-stage predictions, keeps at least 90% of the fitted update after rank truncation, and stays within its update budget. Admissible candidates are ranked lexicographically by PSR, Rep., mean absolute margin drift on the preservation examples, and binary KL on the same examples, with ties broken toward smaller κ \kappa , ε \varepsilon , and r W r_{W} . All hyperparameters are selected by this procedure on the development split, and the test sets play no role in selection.

blocks.en: Given the accusation alone, unedited Qwen establishes the charge for 93.8% of the texts, nearly as often as with the full facts (97.7%). PROSE lowers this rate to 10.3% while still establishing 86.1% of the fully evidenced texts, and it steepens the margin increase from Zero to Full from 0.58 to 0.74. blocks.en: SFT establishes the charge for nearly every text at every level, and its mean margin is lower for Partial (4.13) and Full (4.59) than for Zero (4.84), so its margin does not grow with evidence ( Δ ​ s = − 0.25 \Delta s=-0.25 ). A different threshold cannot fix this: we raise the SFT threshold until its Zero-level rate is closest to that of PROSE, which happens at t = 6.25 t=6.25 given tied margins (12.5% vs. 10.3%). The Partial and Full rates then drop to 12.7% and 18.7%, so fully evidenced texts are rejected almost as often as accusation-only ones, and on the CAIL-MC test pairs FNR rises from 0.26 to 52.61 (Acc 73.65, PSR 37.60). SFT’s verdicts therefore do not encode evidence sufficiency at any operating point.

blocks.en:
The effects are stage- and backbone-dependent rather than monotonic. Combining stages generally broadens coverage, and OUC gives the strongest pooled PSR on GLM. On Qwen, UC has a slightly higher pooled PSR than OUC, whereas OUC performs better on offense-stage pairs. Thus, no fixed subset
dominates across backbones and legal stages and the three-stage decomposition provides complementary, stage-aware coverage.
blocks.zh:
其影响是依赖阶段和主干而不是单调的. 结合阶段一般会扩大覆盖范围,而联合教育组织则在GLM上提供最强的集合PSR. 在Quen上,统一指挥系统的总和PSR略高于联合指挥系统,而联合指挥系统在犯罪阶段的对战中表现更好。 因此,没有固定子集
跨骨干和法律阶段的分解具有主导作用,三阶段分解提供补充性、有阶段意识的覆盖。
